source: docs/blueprint/lucent-desktop-raw-processing-blueprint.md, section 3, table 'Qualification family / Initial target samples / Required distinctions'
match_rules: A fixture matches a target when every criterion given holds for its mode key (mode_key.hpp): make, model (any of), model_not (none of), container (any of), compression, lossiness, area, representation_prefix, view, subimage_count_min, subimage_count_max. A target without criteria ("match": null) is documented but cannot be matched yet.

families.name: Canon
families.blueprint_targets: EOS R5 RAW and C-RAW; at least one additional CR2/CR3 model.
families.required_distinctions: Compression, dimensions, bit depth, crop mode, lens, orientation; do not promise Dual Pixel processing merely because ordinary RAW decoding works.
